# Operating-system and editor noise
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
Desktop.ini
*~
*.swp
*.swo
.idea/
.vscode/*
!.vscode/extensions.json
!.vscode/settings.json

# Secrets and local environment
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
*.pem
*.key
*.p12
*.pfx
secrets/

# Logs, temporary files, and local state
*.log
*.tmp
*.temp
*.pid
.cache/
.tmp/
tmp/
coverage/
.coverage
htmlcov/
.eos/cache/

# Build and package output
build/
dist/
out/
target/
bin/
obj/
*.tgz
*.zip

# JavaScript and TypeScript
node_modules/
.npm/
.pnpm-store/
.yarn/cache/
.yarn/unplugged/
.turbo/
.next/

# Python
__pycache__/
*.py[cod]
.pytest_cache/
.mypy_cache/
.ruff_cache/
.tox/
.nox/
.venv/
venv/

# Go
*.test
*.out
vendor/

# Rust
**/*.rs.bk

# Java and JVM
.gradle/
*.class
*.jar

# Infrastructure and local deployment state
.terraform/
*.tfstate
*.tfstate.*
.serverless/
.aws-sam/

# Keep dependency lockfiles committed for reproducibility. Do not add lockfiles
# here unless the selected ecosystem explicitly requires otherwise.
